titles.A: Lace-Up Chunky Casual Shoes with Stitched Panels and Sculpted PVC Sole for Utility Style Outfits
titles.B: Panelled Casual Shoes with Rear Pull Loop and Chunky PVC Sole for Everyday Footwear Collections

custom: Lace-up; layered stitching; rear pull loop; sculpted PVC sole
highlights:
Panelled casual upper: Curved stitched overlays, a contrasting side insert and small visible perforations define the utility-inspired profile.

Adjustable lace front: Lace guides across the tongue let the buyer adjust the fastening at the instep.

Sculpted PVC sole: The supplier identifies the sole as PVC. Raised sidewall sections and a contrast heel accent give the shoe a pronounced casual outline.

Rear pull loop: A low-top collar and rear loop provide a place to grip the shoe when putting it on.

Assortment planning: Black and Brown are currently listed in EU38-45. Send colour-size quantities, packing preference and destination for a wholesale quotation.
dedup: Exact source URL/artno checked against unique registry; not currently adopted by another family. Raw photos reviewed in full, sidebar excluded; actual markings kept, no invented material or performance.
